decisions.reason: The formwork profile system has its own page, which signals visible commitment and investment, and it sits at the core of the firm's formwork offer, so dropping it would write off that investment and call the earlier decision into question.

The shuttering magnet block is only mentioned and carries little public commitment, but it is a low-cost addition close to the established offer and nothing suggests its results are poor enough to justify withdrawing it.
This magnetic formwork component is presented on its own page and fits the firm's announced direction in formwork, so management's visible commitment favors keeping it.

Investment and public commitment are low, which makes dropping easier, as the earlier removal of the similar magnetic strips (Product D) shows, but the component still fits the core product range and there is no clear evidence that it is failing.
